summary: Healthcare Triangle filed an 8-K reporting two financings: (1) a private placement of senior convertible notes with 15% OID, aggregate principal $4.235M, gross proceeds ~$3.6M; notes mature Dec 12, 2026, convertible after six months at 85% of VWAP minus floor, prepayable at 102.5%, and (2) an equity line with Hudson Global Ventures. Neither constitutes a standard special situation. These are capital-raising transactions, not a merger, tender, or strategic review. The filing triggers Items 1.01, 2.03, and 3.02 but does not fit defined special-situation categories.
